profile.raw_text:
# [NAME] Mahendra Prasetya

Jakarta, Indonesia · [EMAIL]

CV as of 30 September 2026. "Present" refers to this date.

## Summary

Machine learning engineer with three years of experience across two software companies, building NLP services and an internal RAG assistant.

## Experience

**Machine Learning Engineer**, PT Contoh Solusi Bahasa, Jakarta · April 2025 - present
- Fine-tuned a compact text classifier with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers for production ticket routing; reviewed minority-class errors with support agents.
- Built an internal RAG assistant over about 150 support documents with embeddings and PostgreSQL pgvector. Checked passages and answers on 60 manually written questions before a limited rollout.
- Maintained a FastAPI service in Docker on AWS EC2, with artifacts in S3; worked with backend engineers on failed requests and rollbacks.
- Added pytest checks and a GitHub Actions pipeline for tests and container builds. Production releases still require manual approval.

**Junior Machine Learning Engineer**, PT Contoh Layanan Digital, Jakarta · October 2023 - March 2025
- Built a six-category ticket classifier using TF-IDF and logistic regression in scikit-learn, then supported its use on roughly 2,000 tickets per week.
- Used Python and SQL to prepare training data and review mislabeled examples with support agents.
- Packaged predictions behind a REST API and helped deploy the Docker image under a senior engineer's review.

## Education

**Bachelor of Informatics (S1 Informatika)**, Institut Teknologi Contoh Jakarta · September 2019 - August 2023
- Thesis: "Text Classification for Customer Support Requests"

## Projects

**Batch Prediction Monitor** · 2024 (personal project)
- Built a local Python report to flag missing predictions and unusually slow batches using synthetic CSV inputs. It was not connected to a production service.

## Skills

Python, SQL, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, FastAPI, PostgreSQL pgvector, Docker, AWS (EC2, S3), Git, GitHub Actions, pytest, Kubernetes (basic), Terraform (basic)

## Courses

- Introduction to Computer Vision, Contoh Learning Studio · June 2026 (course completed, no certificate)

## Languages

Indonesian (native), English (professional working proficiency)
